name: Utility disconnection threat with an urgent unofficial payment
description: A message threatens imminent disconnection of electricity/gas/service and demands an urgent payment through an unofficial link or number.

source_references.quote: Bank Account / Payment Wallet / SIM / Gas / Electricity / KYC update, impersonation as Government official, sextortion etc.

explanation.plain: A message says your electricity/gas will be cut off today unless you pay now through this link. Real utilities do not work by same-day threats and unofficial links. Verify with your provider.
explanation.technical: SUSPENSION_THREAT (pressure) + payment demand + urgency/link. Chakshu lists gas/electricity among impersonation fraud categories.
verification_steps: Pay bills only through your provider's official app or biller.
Call your utility on the number on a past bill to confirm.
explanation.why_confidence_limited: Chakshu (SRC-007) substantiates the utility-fraud category but not the full disconnection-plus-unofficial-link mechanic; the original HDFC basis is dead (D5). Capped at PARTIAL.

provenance.notes: Encoded in the WP3 rule-encoding pass; suppression via negative-indicator-library-v1.json.
